mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates applied to future cash flows reduce the present value of expected corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS increase, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression controlling for inflation and earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market activity) above the 12-month moving average coincides with stronger consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 12-month moving average by >10% in the next month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20 days after the trigger, or regression p-value > 0.05 with controls for GDP and inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (industrial production) grows faster than CPIAUCSL (inflation) over the next 2 months, it indicates outpacing cost pressures that boost corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth rate > CPIAUCSL growth rate over the next 2 months
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 60 days, or interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (industrial production) for three consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, which reduces earnings expectations and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO decline, or effect is not robust (p > 0.05) in a time series model.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where FEDFUNDS remains below 2%, the lower discounting of future cash flows increases equity present value, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS rises during the window, invalidating the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 4% triggers a labor market tightening that increases wage growth expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% in the next week
failure_condition: No positive 5-day forward return after the trigger, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) unexpectedly exceeds 2% above its prior month, it signals resilient consumer demand that lifts earnings forecasts and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >2% relative to prior month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20 days, or the effect is not robust in a regression with controls for GDP and consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining GDPC1 (GDP) by over 1% indicate weakening aggregate demand, which reduces future earnings expectations and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines by >1% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite GDP decline, or the relationship is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
